build_wpo_learner: build a WPOLearner instance with JAX networks, replay buffer iterator, and optax optimizers for WPO training
create_training_state: create a TrainingState namedtuple holding network params, dual params, optimizer states, and random keys
run_sgd_step: run an SGD step that computes WPO policy and critic losses and updates network and dual parameters
compute_wpo_loss: compute the combined WPO policy loss and critic distributional loss given model predictions and targets
review_distributional_loss: review the distributional loss function that computes MSE between critic predictions and target Q-values
